tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The thick cartoon outline on every drawn shape: aircraft, runways, buttons, panels, HUD chips. Never pure black. Also the colour of hard lip shadows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken. The same in both themes: panels stay paper-light at night.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and hints on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: The label of a disabled control, and the quietest text on paper. Never for text a player must read to continue.

tokens.name: on-sky
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed straight on bg-sky, sky-100 or sky-300, outside any panel: menu titles, version line.

tokens.name: on-sky-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text straight on bg-sky, sky-100 or sky-300.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any bright fill: sun, tangerine, cherry, success, sky-500, star and every path colour. Dark in both themes because the fills stay bright.

tokens.name: on-outline
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an outline-coloured fill: coach marks, tooltips, the callsign tag.

tokens.name: bg-sky
tokens.usage: Background of menus and every non-gameplay screen. The sky the UI lives in.

tokens.name: bg-field
tokens.usage: Background of the gameplay viewport: the airfield lawn.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, level cards and HUD chips. Paper-light in both themes so the outline always reads.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: A surface sitting on a surface: toggle knobs, the selected segment, score popups.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells and tracks: toggle track, segmented control trough, empty life slots, locked level art.

tokens.name: paper-0
tokens.usage: The lightest paper: the face of a ghost button, a toggle knob, a level-card lock badge.

tokens.name: paper-100
tokens.usage: The default surface: panels, dialogs, flight strips, level cards. Same values as the v1 surface token.

tokens.name: paper-200
tokens.usage: A band on paper: a panel header, the label cell of a flight strip, the face of a disabled control.

tokens.name: paper-300
tokens.usage: Wells and keylines: the toggle track, the segmented trough, lines between stat cells, the lip of a ghost button.

tokens.name: paper-400
tokens.usage: The lip of panels, dialogs and level cards; the inner top edge of a well.

tokens.name: paper-500
tokens.usage: Tinted lines on paper: the perforation of a dialog, the dashed rule under a panel header, the bottom edge of a paper lip.

tokens.name: sky-100
tokens.usage: Quietest backdrop tint on bg-sky: far cloud bank, sunburst rays on menus. Text on it is on-sky.

tokens.name: sky-300
tokens.usage: Backdrop stripes and near cloud bank on bg-sky. Text on it is on-sky.

tokens.name: sky-500
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill, info status, active toggle track. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: sky-700
tokens.usage: Links and emphasised text on surface and surface-raised; lip under sky-500 fills.

tokens.name: sky-900
tokens.usage: The bottom edge of a sky lip. sky-700 is the lip of a secondary button; sky-100 and sky-300 are its tint and highlight.

tokens.name: grass-300
tokens.usage: Light mowing stripe and grass tufts on the field.

tokens.name: grass-400
tokens.usage: Light patches in unmown meadow, and the ground inside a paddock.

tokens.name: grass-500
tokens.usage: Base lawn colour of the airfield.

tokens.name: grass-600
tokens.usage: The darker mowing stripe of the airfield lawn, and dark patches in the meadow. One step from grass-500, so stripes stay quiet.

tokens.name: grass-700
tokens.usage: Dark mowing stripe, taxiway verge, bushes.

tokens.name: grass-900
tokens.usage: Hedge and tree shade; grass detail next to asphalt.

tokens.name: asphalt-300
tokens.usage: Runway shoulder and apron wear.

tokens.name: asphalt-500
tokens.usage: Runway, taxiway and helipad surface.

tokens.name: asphalt-700
tokens.usage: Tyre marks and the touchdown zone on the runway.

tokens.name: asphalt-900
tokens.usage: Tyres and the dark inside of an open hangar door.

tokens.name: marking
tokens.usage: Runway centre line, threshold bars, numbers and the helipad H, on asphalt-500 and asphalt-700.

tokens.name: marking-warn
tokens.usage: Helipad ring and hold-short lines, on asphalt-500 and asphalt-700.

tokens.name: sand-300

tokens.name: sand-500

tokens.name: soil-700

tokens.name: roof-500

tokens.name: roof-300

tokens.name: roof-700

tokens.name: roof-900

tokens.name: foam

tokens.name: stone-300

tokens.name: stone-700

tokens.name: pine-900

tokens.name: wood-300

tokens.name: wood-500
tokens.usage: Scenery only. Trunks, fences, doors, jetties. Step 500: the base tone.

tokens.name: wood-700

tokens.name: wood-900

tokens.name: straw-700

tokens.name: wall-300

tokens.name: wall-500
tokens.usage: Scenery only. Plastered walls. The cream that stands in for white on the ground: scenery never uses the fuselage white. Step 500: the shadow under the eaves.

tokens.name: tin-100
tokens.usage: Scenery only. Metal roofs, tanks, silos, parked aircraft. A cool grey, apart from the blue-grey asphalt. Step 100: the brightest band of a curved roof.

tokens.name: tin-300
tokens.usage: Scenery only. Metal roofs, tanks, silos, parked aircraft. A cool grey, apart from the blue-grey asphalt. Step 300: the lit tone.

tokens.name: tin-500
tokens.usage: Scenery only. Metal roofs, tanks, silos, parked aircraft. A cool grey, apart from the blue-grey asphalt. Step 500: the shade tone.

tokens.name: tin-700
tokens.usage: Scenery only. Metal roofs, tanks, silos, parked aircraft. A cool grey, apart from the blue-grey asphalt. Step 700: the deepest shade and roof seams.

tokens.name: tin-900
tokens.usage: Scenery only. Metal roofs, tanks, silos, parked aircraft. A cool grey, apart from the blue-grey asphalt. Step 900: tinted lines on metal.

tokens.name: concrete-300
tokens.usage: Aprons, helipad pads, runway shoulders, kerbs. Step 300: the slab.

tokens.name: concrete-500
tokens.usage: Aprons, helipad pads, runway shoulders, kerbs. Step 500: slab joints and the runway shoulder.

tokens.name: concrete-700
tokens.usage: Aprons, helipad pads, runway shoulders, kerbs. Step 700: the edge of a slab.

tokens.name: road-500
tokens.usage: Scenery only. Public roads: lighter than a runway, so a road never looks like a place to land. Step 500: the surface.

tokens.name: road-700
tokens.usage: Scenery only. Public roads: lighter than a runway, so a road never looks like a place to land. Step 700: the kerb line.

tokens.name: water-300
tokens.usage: Ponds, waterholes and the sea. Step 300: the shallows along a shore.

tokens.name: water-500
tokens.usage: Ponds, waterholes and the sea. Step 500: open water. The same blue as sky-500.

tokens.name: water-700
tokens.usage: Ponds, waterholes and the sea. Step 700: the edge between shallows and shore.

tokens.name: hide-100
tokens.usage: Scenery only. Animals. Step 100: a pale coat.

tokens.name: hide-300
tokens.usage: Scenery only. Animals. Step 300: the shaded flank and ears.

tokens.name: hide-900
tokens.usage: Scenery only. Animals. Step 900: patches, hooves and stripes.

tokens.name: denim-300
tokens.usage: Scenery only. Car paint, a step muted so no car looks like an aircraft livery. Step 300: the roof.

tokens.name: denim-500
tokens.usage: Scenery only. Car paint, a step muted so no car looks like an aircraft livery. Step 500: the body.

tokens.name: sun

tokens.usage: Highlight on a sun fill: the top edge of a primary button, the label cell of the score strip.

tokens.usage: Base tone of the sun ramp. The same colour as sun.

tokens.name: sun-700
tokens.usage: Lip of a sun control; the edge of a sun chip. Replaces sun-deep.

tokens.name: sun-900
tokens.usage: The bottom edge of a sun lip.

tokens.name: tangerine
tokens.usage: Streak badge, highlights, second aircraft livery. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: tangerine-deep
tokens.usage: Lip and pressed shade under tangerine fills.

tokens.name: tangerine-200
tokens.usage: Highlight on a tangerine fill.

tokens.name: tangerine-500
tokens.usage: Base tone of the tangerine ramp. The same colour as tangerine.

tokens.name: tangerine-700
tokens.usage: Lower edge of a tangerine sticker. Replaces tangerine-deep.

tokens.name: tangerine-900
tokens.usage: The darkest tangerine: a tinted line on a tangerine fill.

tokens.name: cherry
tokens.usage: Lives, destructive buttons, collision alerts. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: cherry-deep
tokens.usage: Lip and pressed shade under cherry fills.

tokens.name: cherry-200
tokens.usage: Highlight on a cherry fill; the header band of a dialog that reports a failure; the face of the control tower roof in light.

tokens.name: cherry-500
tokens.usage: Base tone of the cherry ramp. The same colour as cherry.

tokens.name: cherry-700
tokens.usage: Lip of a danger button; the edge of a cherry chip; the stamp on a dialog. Replaces cherry-deep.

tokens.name: cherry-900
tokens.usage: The bottom edge of a cherry lip; text of a stamp.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Safe landing, valid landing zone glow, confirmations. A teal, not a green, so it reads on the lawn and stays apart from cherry for colour-blind players. Always paired with a check icon or a word. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: mint-200
tokens.usage: Highlight on a mint fill; the header band of a dialog that reports success.

tokens.name: mint-500
tokens.usage: Base tone of the mint ramp. The same colour as success: the track of a toggle that is on, threshold lights.

tokens.name: mint-700
tokens.usage: The inner top edge of a toggle track that is on; the edge of a mint chip.

tokens.name: mint-900
tokens.usage: Text and icons on mint-200; the check in a toggle that is on. The same colour as success-ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Collision, miss, wrong landing zone. Always paired with a warning icon or a word.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Danger text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Near-miss warning ring between two aircraft.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral hints: next-aircraft arrow, tutorial pulses.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Inner band of the two-tone focus ring: 3px focus, then 3px outline outside it. One of the two bands always holds 3:1 against whatever the ring lands on.

tokens.name: path-1
tokens.usage: Flight path and livery of the 1st aircraft on screen. Path colours are assigned in order and reused once an aircraft lands.

tokens.name: path-2
tokens.usage: Flight path and livery, 2nd aircraft.

tokens.name: path-3
tokens.usage: Flight path and livery, 3rd aircraft.

tokens.name: path-4
tokens.usage: Flight path and livery, 4th aircraft. Bubblegum.

tokens.name: path-5
tokens.usage: Flight path and livery, 5th aircraft. Grape.

tokens.name: path-6
tokens.usage: Flight path and livery, 6th aircraft. Lagoon.

tokens.name: fuselage
tokens.usage: Aircraft body white.

tokens.name: fuselage-shade
tokens.usage: Engines, nacelles and the shaded side of the fuselage.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Cockpit windows. Keep them big.

tokens.name: glass-700
tokens.usage: Mullions and the lower rim of glass on buildings: the tinted line of glass.

tokens.name: window
tokens.usage: Scenery only. A window of a building: glass by day, a warm light in Night and Dawn.

tokens.name: beacon

tokens.name: muzzle

tokens.name: glass-shine
tokens.usage: The single highlight streak on a cockpit window.

tokens.name: prop-blur
tokens.usage: Translucent disc of a spinning rotor.

tokens.name: cloud
tokens.usage: Ambient drifting clouds above the field, drawn at opacity-cloud.

tokens.name: cloud-shade
tokens.usage: Underside of clouds.

tokens.name: shadow-ground
tokens.usage: The soft shadow an aircraft or cloud casts on the ground.

tokens.name: shadow-cast
tokens.usage: The hard shadow anything standing on the ground casts down-right. Drawn as one layer at opacity-shadow-cast, so overlapping shadows never darken twice.

tokens.name: select-ring
tokens.usage: Dashed ring around the selected aircraft. Always drawn over an outline-coloured casing, like the flight path.

tokens.name: zone-ok
tokens.usage: Glow on a runway or helipad while the path end is a valid landing.

tokens.name: zone-no
tokens.usage: Glow on a landing zone of the wrong type for the selected aircraft.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Star burst on a safe landing; streak sparkles.

tokens.name: poof

tokens.name: poof-shade

tokens.name: scrim

tokens.name: contact

tokens.name: contact-field
tokens.usage: The flat contact shadow under anything in the HUD: flight strips, stickers, the pause button, coach marks.

tokens.name: contact-overlay
tokens.usage: The flat contact shadow under a dialog on the scrim.

tokens.name: blackout
tokens.usage: Opaque near-black navy that the game screen fades to after a collision, leaving only the two colliding aircraft. Same in Day and Night.
